attempts.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE inheritance_tree AS (
  -- Base case: ClickException itself
  SELECT symbol_id, qualname, 0 AS depth
  FROM code.symbols
  WHERE qualname = 'ClickException'

  UNION ALL

  -- Recursive case: find direct subclasses
  SELECT s.symbol_id, s.qualname, it.depth + 1
  FROM code.symbols s
  JOIN inheritance_tree it ON s.qualname = it.qualname || '." || s.name || '"'
  WHERE s.kind = 'class'
    AND s.qualname != it.qualname
    AND s.qualname NOT IN (SELECT qualname FROM inheritance_tree)
)
SELECT symbol_id, depth AS inheritance_depth
FROM inheritance_tree
WHERE depth > 0
ORDER BY depth, symbol_id
